description: The file planView.php is a PHP script responsible for rendering the test plan view in the TestLink project management application. It initializes the page, checks user rights, fetches test plans and associated custom fields, and prepares the data for display via the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing test project ID, name, and current user from session variables.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Constructs and returns a GUI object with test project information, user permissions, and editor configuration.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to create or manage test plans within a specific test project.
